versions.subject: Merge PR #5725 from @Koifman - RDP Enable or Disable via Win32_TerminalServiceSetting WMI Class
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\wmic.exe'
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'wmic.exe'
          - 'PowerShell.EXE'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_cli_method:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'rdtoggle'
        - 'Win32_TerminalServiceSetting'
selection_cli_property:
    CommandLine|contains: 'SetAllowTSConnections'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\wmic.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("wmic.exe", "PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine IN ("*rdtoggle*", "*Win32_TerminalServiceSetting*") CommandLine="*SetAllowTSConnections*"
